source: Task completion is bit-packed across these player varps, in task-id order: task i sits in varps[i / 32] at bit i % 32. The list is observable in any client and is published in RuneProfile's public manifest (runeprofile.com/api/manifest), which is where these were read from; the ids are facts about the game, not anyone's code.
note: Served to the plugin through /api/plugin/config so a game update that adds a varp is a data change here, not a plugin release. Every decode is checked against the game's own CA_POINTS total before it is stored.
